subject: Proposal: Monthly Commit Uplift + Burst Consolidation for ClarityMaps
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@claritymaps.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-10T14:03:00-04:00
Subject: Need to discuss commit uplift before renewal

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well — usage momentum for our new recommendation feature has outpaced projections and we’re looking to lock in higher monthly commits ahead of our renewal. Our current pattern shows a 3x increase in monthly token consumption vs. last quarter and we expect continued growth as we roll the feature to more customers.

High level ask: 1) Move our hosted API monthly commit from 2.5M -> 7.5M tokens/mo, 2) Consolidate our existing burst pocket into the main monthly commit to simplify billing, 3) Clarify proration for the mid-cycle uplift and any SLA implications.

I’ve attached a short renewal sketch (ClarityMaps_Renewal_Proposal_Mar2028.pdf) that includes forecasted volumes and our preferred billing cadence. Can you route this to the right folks and propose a pricing path & timeline? We’re hoping to finalize terms before March 24 to align with procurement.

Thanks,
Sarah
Head of Product, ClarityMaps
---
Attachment: ClarityMaps_Renewal_Proposal_Mar2028.pdf (pdf, 94KB)
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@claritymaps.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Need to discuss commit uplift before renewal

Hi Sarah — thanks for the context and the attachment. Appreciate the forecast.

Quick responses up front: we can support a 3x uplift but will want to do this with a staged ramp and consolidated burst approach so we don’t create provisioning pressure across the fleet. Things we need from you to size the right offer:
- 6 months of daily token histograms (to estimate tail vs. steady-state).
- Expected % of traffic that needs <50ms p95 latency vs. lower latency tiers.
- Billing contact for procurement and any PO/delegation details.

Options we can put on the table:
A) Immediate uplift to 7.5M/mo with a short staged guardrail (30% burst window) and 6-week provisioning lead; standard committed-rate band pricing.
B) 6-month ramp: 2.5M -> 5M -> 7.5M with a step discount applied at each milestone; faster provisioning with a smaller initial allocation.
C) Consolidate burst into commit and provide a one-time credit for historical burst usage if you sign a 12-month term.

I’m attaching the redwood-pricing-model.xlsx (pricing bands + examples) for transparency. I’ll coordinate with Karthik on margin/ops constraints and loop in Jordan if we need a service-level carveout.

Proposed next step: 30-min call tomorrow (2028-03-12) with product + procurement to align on telemetry and preferred path. Does 10:30 PT work?

Best,
Soojin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood-pricing-model.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28KB)
From: procure@claritymaps.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Aaron Gill <aaron@claritymaps.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah@claritymaps.com>
Date: 2028-03-12T10:07:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Need to discuss commit uplift before renewal

Soojin,

Thanks for the outline. From procurement’s side: we prefer a clear single monthly commit (for budget predictability) rather than keeping a separate burst pocket. Our ask is: 7.5M tokens/mo consolidated, price target at a 22% blended discount to current effective rate, and proration to start on the date the new commit is active (we will sign a 12-month contract).

We can route the PO quickly provided the pricing and term match our expectations. Here is our DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/CLM-2028-0892-sign

Please confirm you can meet the price target or propose the closest alternative.

Aaron
Procurement Manager, ClarityMaps
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-13T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: margin/ops on ClarityMaps uplift

Internal notes for presentation to customer — do not forward as-is.

Summary of customer ask: consolidate burst, move commit 2.5M -> 7.5M, 12-month term, ask for ~22% blended discount.

Considerations:
- Provisioning lead: 4–6 weeks to reassign pool capacity to a dedicated burst cushion if needed; immediate shifts will cause transient soft-throttling risk during peak rollout.
- Margin math: with a straight 22% blended discount we compress margin below our acceptable floor unless we include conditional incentives (usage tiers, staged ramp).
- Suggested commercial counter: staged ramp to 7.5M over 3 billing cycles (month 1: 4.0M, month 2: 6.0M, month 3+: 7.5M) with a 10% immediate discount at signature and additional 8% step discount once they hit 90% of a step for two consecutive billing cycles. Include one-time credit to reconcile past burst usage.
- Operational guardrails: 30% burst window as safety, auto-fallback to thinner model variant if p95 latency SLOs are violated (needs CS/infra signoff).

Numbers example (illustrative):
- Current effective blended rate: $0.0024 per 1K tokens -> current monthly commit cost $6,000 (2.5M tokens).
- Proposed blended after staged discounts: $0.00195 per 1K tokens -> effective monthly at 7.5M = $14,625 after discounts at steady state (numbers for negotiation).

Ask: Jordan to validate the fallback plan and lead times; Vanessa to confirm billing/proration language and how the credit would be reflected. I’ll prep a 1-pager for the customer call.

-Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@claritymaps.com>, Aaron Gill <aaron@claritymaps.com>, procure@claritymaps.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-15T11:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Need to discuss commit uplift before renewal — proposed path forward

Hi Aaron / Sarah — appreciate the quick turnaround from procurement. After internal alignment we can do the following offer to move forward quickly:

Proposed commercial summary:
- Term: 12 months, start date when the new commit is activated.
- Commit: staged ramp over 3 billing cycles: 4.0M -> 6.0M -> 7.5M tokens/mo.
- Pricing: 10% signing credit applied immediately; an additional 8% step discount applied on each step once usage hits >=90% of the step for two consecutive cycles. Blended example rate at steady state approximately 18–20% below current effective rate.
- Burst: consolidated into commit with a 30% burst window and a one-time reconciliation credit for historical burst usage (amount based on the last 6 months usage).
- Provisioning lead: 4 weeks to fully provision dedicated capacity for the burst cushion; we will enable partial capacity within 10 days.
- SLA: existing latency SLOs unchanged; auto-fallback policy to maintain availability during extreme load.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the staged ramp + consolidation approach by EOD 2028-03-17 so we can start provisioning.
2) If accepted, we’ll generate an updated SOW and DocuSign package (you’ll see the link from us).
3) We’ll run a quick telemetry sync to validate p95 targets — can your product team share the six months of daily token histograms?

If this aligns I’ll send the DocuSign wrapper and the SOW tomorrow.

Thanks,
Soojin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---

Soojin — this works for us.

We accept the staged ramp and consolidation approach. Procurement will expect the DocuSign package and SOW; we will send the six months of daily token histograms by close of business today.

Please include the one-time reconciliation credit in the SOW and flag the provisioning lead time so we can coordinate our rollout schedule. Once we have the DocuSign link we’ll route it internally for signature.

Thanks again — excited to get this across the finish line.

—Sarah
Head of Product, ClarityMaps
